rules.statement: The Petitioner Bank is entitled to execute the writ notwithstanding the notice of appeal, as Act No. 4 of 1990 has not provided for a right of appeal against an order made by the District Court in terms of Section 16 of the said Act.
rules.supporting_quote: Act No. 4 of 1990 has not provided for a right of appeal against an order made by the District Court in terms of Section 16 of the said Act.
